# Documentation

Documentation and the namespace are generated only after every canonical
module and test resource has been installed.

```{r document-package, include=FALSE}
devtools::load_all(usethis::proj_get(), quiet = TRUE)
litr::document()
```

Run the full package check separately so the literate render cannot launch or
mask a check failure:

```{r check-package, eval=FALSE}
devtools::check("eivGP", document = FALSE)
```
